name: Exp_Bear_Bulls_Power
summary: This EA trades based on the Bears Power and Bulls Power indicators developed by Alexander Elder. It enters long positions when Bulls Power is positive and rising, and short positions when Bears Power is negative and falling, using EMA as the trend filter.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Alexander Elder开发的空头力量和多头力量指标进行交易。当多头力量为正且上升时做多，当空头力量为负且下降时做空，使用EMA作为趋势过滤器。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Elder射线理论，通过衡量多空力量来判断市场主导方向。入场条件：多头力量指标为正值且上升时开多单，空头力量指标为负值且下降时开空单，同时EMA用于确认趋势方向。出场条件包括固定止损止盈以及指标反转信号平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面提供了风险百分比参数来控制每笔交易的风险敞口。整体策略属于动量跟随类型，适合趋势明显的市场环境。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Elder Ray theory, measuring bullish and bearish forces to determine market dominance. Entry conditions: long positions are opened when Bulls Power is positive and rising, while short positions are opened when Bears Power is negative and falling, with EMA serving as the trend confirmation filter. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, as well as indicator reversal signals for position closing. Position sizing employs either fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management provides risk percentage parameters to control the risk exposure per trade. The overall strategy is a momentum-following type, suitable for markets with clear trending conditions.

pros: 策略基于经典Elder射线理论，逻辑清晰且有理论支撑
多空力量指标能直观反映市场买卖压力，信号直观易懂
结合EMA趋势过滤，减少震荡市中的虚假信号
提供固定手数和动态手数两种仓位管理方式，灵活性好
止损止盈参数明确，风险可控
pros_en: Strategy based on classic Elder Ray theory with clear logic and theoretical support
Bears/Bulls Power indicators intuitively reflect market buying/selling pressure with easy-to-understand signals
EMA trend filter reduces false signals in ranging markets
Offers both fixed and dynamic lot sizing for flexible position management
Clear stop loss and take profit parameters provide controllable risk
cons: 动量策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下入场成本可能过高
依赖单一指标组合，缺乏多维度确认机制
缺少移动止损功能，盈利头寸可能大幅回吐
cons_en: Momentum strategy prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening repeated positions on the same bar
No spread filter, resulting in potentially high entry costs in high-spread environments
Relies on single indicator combination without multi-dimensional confirmation
Lacks trailing stop functionality, profitable positions may give back significant gains
improvements: 增加新K线检查机制，避免同一根K线上重复开仓
添加点差过滤和波动率过滤，提高入场质量
加入移动止损功能，保护浮动利润
增加多时间框架确认，提高信号可靠性
加入最大连续亏损限制和整体资金回撤保护
improvements_en: Add new bar check mechanism to prevent repeated position opening on the same bar
Add spread filter and volatility filter to improve entry quality
Implement trailing stop functionality to protect floating profits
Add multi-timeframe confirmation to improve signal reliability
Add maximum consecutive loss limit and overall drawdown protection

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上多次开仓导致仓位过重
动量策略在震荡市中可能产生连续亏损
没有点差过滤，高点差环境可能侵蚀利润
risk_points_en: Lacks new bar check, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar leading to overexposure
Momentum strategy may produce consecutive losses in ranging markets
No spread filter, high spread environments may erode profits
